Sandbox_PhleaMarket_Enabled_tooltip: Turn the player market off entirely. Existing listings are left alone and become reachable again if you turn it back on.
Sandbox_PhleaMarket_SimulatedSellers_too: Fill the market with listings from survivors who do not exist, so it is worth visiting on a quiet server. Also what makes the machine appear in singleplayer, where there is otherwise nobody to buy from.
Sandbox_PhleaMarket_SimulatedCount_toolt: How many listings the simulated sellers keep on the market. They are drawn from what the machines themselves sell, at prices around what the machines charge, so the fake market stays anchored to your economy. Only used when simulated sellers are on.
Sandbox_PhleaMarket_DurationShortHours_t: How long a short listing stays up, in in-game hours. Set all three durations to the same number for a single fixed listing length.
Sandbox_PhleaMarket_DurationMediumHours_: How long a medium listing stays up, in in-game hours. This is the length offered by default when a seller lists something.
Sandbox_PhleaMarket_DurationLongHours_to: How long a long listing stays up, in in-game hours.
Sandbox_PhleaMarket_DurationMediumMult_t: Multiplies the listing fee for a medium listing. A short listing is always charged once.
Sandbox_PhleaMarket_DurationLongMult_too: Multiplies the listing fee for a long listing. Waiting longer for a buyer costs more.
Sandbox_PhleaMarket_ListingFeeMode_toolt: Whether the fee to put something up is a share of the asking price or a flat charge. A flat charge asks the same to list one nail as to list a gold bar.
Sandbox_PhleaMarket_ListingFeePercent_to: Share of the asking total charged when a listing goes up, before the duration multiplier. Non-refundable. Zero makes listing free.
Sandbox_PhleaMarket_ListingFeeFixed_tool: Flat amount charged when a listing goes up, before the duration multiplier. Only used when the listing fee is set to a fixed amount.
Sandbox_PhleaMarket_ListingFeeMin_toolti: The least a listing may cost to put up, whatever the percentage works out to. A percentage of a very cheap listing rounds down to nothing, so without a floor the cheapest listings are free and the fee stops discouraging spam exactly where spam is cheapest. Zero leaves it off.
Sandbox_PhleaMarket_CommissionMode_toolt: Whether the house takes a share of each sale or a flat cut. This is the main currency sink in the market.
Sandbox_PhleaMarket_CommissionPercent_to: Share of the sale taken from the seller's proceeds, applied per unit sold. Worked out when the listing goes up, so a seller sees their exact take-home before confirming.
Sandbox_PhleaMarket_CommissionFixed_tool: Flat amount taken from the seller's proceeds per sale. Only used when commission is set to a fixed amount.
Sandbox_PhleaMarket_FeePool_tooltip: Which PhunMart wallet pool fees are taken from. Leave as change unless you have added a pool of your own.
Sandbox_PhleaMarket_MaxListings_tooltip: How many listings one account may have up at once. Counted per account, not per character, so a new survivor does not get a fresh allowance.
Sandbox_PhleaMarket_MaxStackQty_tooltip: Ceiling on how many of one item a single listing may hold. Only items where every one is interchangeable can be listed as a stack.
Sandbox_PhleaMarket_MinPrice_tooltip: The least a seller may ask per item, in cents, so 500 is five dollars. Sellers type and read dollars; this is the stored figure. Raised onto the price step if it does not already sit on one.
Sandbox_PhleaMarket_MaxPrice_tooltip: The most a seller may ask per item, in cents, so 9999 is $99.99. Stops a listing nobody could ever afford being used as free storage. If you have scaled PhunMart's own prices up, raise this to match, or the market will not hold what your machines sell. Lowered onto the price step if it does not already sit on one.
Sandbox_PhleaMarket_PriceStep_tooltip: What a price must be a multiple of, in cents, so 100 is one dollar. Five keeps asking prices aligned to the rest of the change economy. A hundred means whole dollars and nothing finer, which is what you want if you have scaled PhunMart's own prices so the machines charge round figures. One allows any amount down to the cent. Anything typed between steps is brought down to the one below it, the minimum and maximum unit price are aligned to it so the range only ever names prices a listing may actually hold, and the simulated sellers price themselves the same way.
Sandbox_PhleaMarket_ReturnsExpiryHours_t: How long an expired item waits to be collected before it is discarded, in in-game hours. Without a limit the save carries every abandoned listing forever.
Sandbox_PhleaMarket_LogEntries_tooltip: How many transactions the admin ledger keeps before the oldest are dropped. This is what settles an argument about who was paid what. Zero turns it off.
